headline: Follow New Zealand power prices
intro: Connect an ecosmart API key to Home Assistant to track the current electricity spot price for each connection point (ICP) on the account. The integration adds a sensor with the price in cents per kilowatt-hour, including GST.
highlights: Enter an API key from the ecosmart app; the integration checks the account and its accessible connection points
Monitor current spot price sensors, which update every five minutes and become unavailable when the reading is stale or has no price
Request wholesale price forecasts on demand for a selected connection point, with prices returned both including and excluding GST

flow.title: From API key to price readings
stages: Enter and verify an ecosmart API key
Load current prices for the account's grid exit points
Read a spot price sensor for each connection point
Request a forecast for a selected connection point
